stops.segment: The Colonels, the Split, and May
stops.stop: Paris, the party splits in two
stops.date_confidence: [A] that he joined and remained a member of the Communist Party of the Interior after the split is attested verbatim by Stuart Hall in New Left Review I/119, in the words quoted. Contradiction flagged and deliberately not resolved: Hall places the split 'in the wake of the Colonel's coup' and the KKE's 12th Plenum formalised it in February 1968, months before the Warsaw Pact invasion of Czechoslovakia that August, whereas en.wikipedia's article on the KKE (Interior) says the split followed that invasion. The research pool asserted the invasion as the cause, which the February date will not support; this file dates the stop to the plenum and lets both accounts stand. Day defaulted; the Paris coordinate is generic, the split being an exile-wide event with no single address.
